text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant… Phew…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is drawing closer, and Seeking the Pearl's breathing is still thin. But as time passes…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her raspy breathing becomes sharper, and her times faster.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We've overcome so many unbelievable obstacles to get here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For a while, I was fine just letting destiny guide me… It was nice, even.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But at some point, that stopped being enough. I started wanting to surpass my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Knowing what your destiny is and surpassing it… That's what people call…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl is aiming to go beyond even the world's highest peak, where she seeks to stand and show everyone the strength of her possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run another lap! This is all so I can make the impossible possible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win against Taiki in a mile! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the day of the race arrives.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Once again the two Umamusume of the hour, Taiki Shuttle and Seeking the Pearl, stand side by side!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: There's no telling what will happen today! But whoever wins will be crowned this year's champion of the sprint!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I know you're thinking you have the advantage this time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You think you've definitely got this in the bag as long as you give it your all, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Do I think that? Well…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, actually! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I reckon I didn't lose last time 'cause I was at a disadvantage or whatnot.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Your strength's the real deal, Pearl! No matter how long or short the race, you always nail it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Knowin' that about you, I dunno if I've definitely got this in the bag…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I'm still gonna win this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! Ahaha, you're the best! You really are a champion who deserves all the respect given to you and more.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we're rivals. If not for you, I wouldn't be taking on a challenge I have almost no chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, then! Here's to our final match of the year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Forget who was the first to conquer the world. Let's see who's the strongest right now! ♪
